basis: 2026-09-17 reviewed MCP economy and reliability contract: public tools keep session/state IDs, delta hashes, native action IDs, combat decision tokens, required fixed map_id/revision, and event reading_id server-side; JSON payloads are single-copy and auto-TOON when losslessly smaller; normal transport/success/mechanics audit metadata and narrative observer bookkeeping are omitted; hand TOC carries current cost; multi-card reads share an inline budget; equivalent hand copies collapse only when complete observed state differs solely by identity/hand-index/render provenance; exact physical refs remain available through context. Only required const/single-enum action parameters are stripped from public schemas/examples and restored from the exact pinned native action before dispatch, preserving optional-parameter semantics. Game-side terminal action errors preserve the original request_id so McpBridge can release its single-flight pending lock after rejected actions instead of permanently returning busy_outcome_pending. Ordinary copied-profile event actions are wired through RunUi/MenuControlSession/ProtocolSession; this is not a claim that every Downfall custom event/minigame/selector has live-game acceptance.
